title.zh: 语言系列模型（目录期初）

summary.en: Chat Completions language brands live on the gateway: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax.

body.en:
Language generation is exposed primarily through **OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions** at `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`.

## Contract shape

- One **complete** docs page per brand (model is an enum on the page).
- Pin live model ids from console pricing / docs enums — do not invent ids.

## Brands in this baseline

| Brand | Example model ids |
| --- | --- |
| Claude | `claude-opus-4-7`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, … |
| GPT | `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, … |
| Gemini | `gemini-3.5-flash`, `gemini-3.1-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, … |
| Grok | `grok-4.5`, `grok-4.3`, `grok-build-0.1`, … |
| DeepSeek | `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` |
| GLM | `glm-5.1`, `glm-5.2` |
| Kimi | `kimi-k2.6`, `kimi-k2.7-code`, `kimi-k3` |
| MiniMax (text) | `minimax-m2.5`, `minimax-m2.7`, `minimax-m3` |

Full id list is in the entry `models` field and on each brand complete page.

## Documentation

Start from the **Language series** tab in the API manual.
body.zh:
语言生成主要通过 **OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions** 暴露：`https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`。

## 调用合同

- 每个品牌一页 **完整参数**（`model` 为页内枚举）。
- model id 以控制台定价 / 文档枚举为准，禁止臆造。

## 本期初覆盖品牌

| 品牌 | 示例 model id |
| --- | --- |
| Claude | `claude-opus-4-7`、`claude-sonnet-5`、`claude-haiku-4-5` 等 |
| GPT | `gpt-5.4`、`gpt-5.5`、`gpt-5.6-terra` 等 |
| Gemini | `gemini-3.5-flash`、`gemini-3.1-pro`、`gemini-2.5-flash` 等 |
| Grok | `grok-4.5`、`grok-4.3`、`grok-build-0.1` 等 |
| DeepSeek | `deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-pro` |
| GLM | `glm-5.1`、`glm-5.2` |
| Kimi | `kimi-k2.6`、`kimi-k2.7-code`、`kimi-k3` |
| MiniMax（文本） | `minimax-m2.5`、`minimax-m2.7`、`minimax-m3` |

完整 id 见本条目 `models` 字段与各品牌完整参数页。

## 文档

见 API 手册 **语言系列** 页签。
